Title: High expression of GTPase regulator associated with the focal adhesion kinase (GRAF) is a favorable prognostic factor in acute myeloid leukemia.
Source: Blood cells, molecules & diseases (2014)
Abstract: BACKGROUND: GRAF is a recognized tumor suppressor gene that was found inactivated in AML. However, the prognostic role of a GRAF transcript has not been studied in patients with AML.
